_note: 特殊句構未覆蓋 KP 補建：完成分詞構句（eng.t_sub.special.perfect-participle，學測/分科級）。Having ＋ 過去分詞 表示一個動作在主句動作「之前」完成：Having finished his work, he went home.（＝After he finished his work, he went home.）。鐵律：(1) 形式＝Having ＋ p.p.，分詞的主詞必須與主句主詞一致（he finished、he went）；(2) 主詞不一致＝垂懸分詞（錯）：×Having finished dinner, the plates were washed.；(3) 被動式＝Having been ＋ p.p.：Having been warned, they stayed home.。防第二正解：distractor 用錯誤形式（Had/base/漏 Having）、主詞不一致的垂懸分詞、主動被動誤用鎖唯一解。皆標準英語，以 Swan/Oxford，待英語母語 reviewer 複核。文法單元無音檔。

units.title_zh: 完成分詞構句（Having finished his work, he went home.）
units.can_do: 我能用完成分詞 Having ＋ 過去分詞，表示一個動作在主句動作之前就完成：Having finished his work, he went home.；我知道分詞的主詞必須和主句主詞一致（否則就是垂懸分詞的錯誤），被動時用 Having been ＋ 過去分詞。
units.situation_group: 特殊句型 The perfect participle
units.subject: eng

claims.text: The perfect participle 'Having + past participle' shows an action finished before the main action: 'Having finished his homework, he went out to play.' (= After he finished his homework, he went out.)
claims.verification_ref: 完成分詞 Having ＋ 過去分詞表示動作在主句動作之前完成；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The subject of the participle must be the same as the subject of the main clause: 'Having locked the door, she left' (she locked and she left).
claims.verification_ref: 分詞的主詞必須與主句主詞一致（she locked、she left）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: If the subjects differ, the sentence has a dangling participle and is wrong: not 'Having finished dinner, the plates were washed' (plates did not finish dinner).
claims.verification_ref: 主詞不一致＝垂懸分詞（錯）；×Having finished dinner, the plates were washed；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The passive perfect participle is 'Having been + past participle': 'Having been told the news, they celebrated.'
claims.verification_ref: 被動完成分詞＝Having been ＋ 過去分詞；Having been told…；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: The perfect participle 'Having + past participle' shows that one action was finished before the main action. It is a short way to say 'After ...': Having finished his homework, he went out to play.
teach.zh_hint: 完成分詞 Having ＋ 過去分詞 表示一個動作在主句動作之前就完成了。它是「After…（在…之後）」的簡短說法：Having finished his homework, he went out to play.（寫完作業後，他出去玩了。）

teach.body: Having locked the door, she walked to the bus stop.
teach.zh_hint: 鎖好門之後，她走向公車站。鎖門在走路之前完成，用 Having locked。

teach.body: The subject of the participle must be the same as the subject of the main clause. So in 'Having read the letter, Mary put it away,' Mary both read the letter and put it away.
teach.zh_hint: 分詞的主詞必須和主句的主詞是同一個。所以在 Having read the letter, Mary put it away（讀完信後，瑪麗把它收起來）裡，讀信和把信收起來的都是 Mary。

teach.body: Having missed the last bus, he decided to walk home.
teach.zh_hint: 錯過末班車後，他決定走路回家。錯過車和決定走路的都是 he，主詞一致。

teach.body: If the subjects are different, the sentence is wrong - this mistake is called a dangling participle: not 'Having finished dinner, the plates were washed' (the plates did not finish dinner).
teach.zh_hint: 如果主詞不一致，句子就錯了——這種錯誤叫「垂懸分詞」：×Having finished dinner, the plates were washed（盤子沒有吃完晚餐）。

teach.body: For a passive meaning, use 'Having been + past participle': Having been warned about the storm, the sailors stayed in port.
teach.zh_hint: 要表示被動時，用 Having been ＋ 過去分詞：Having been warned about the storm, the sailors stayed in port.（獲得暴風雨警告後，水手們留在港口。）

teach.body: Having been told the good news, the whole family celebrated.
teach.zh_hint: 得知好消息後，全家人慶祝了一番。被動用 Having been told，主詞 the whole family 是被告知的對象。

practice.stem: 用完成分詞合併：He finished his homework. Then he went out. 哪一句正確？
practice.answer: Having finished his homework, he went out.
options: Having finished his homework, he went out.
Had finished his homework, he went out.
Having finish his homework, he went out.
Finished his homework, he went out.

分詞構句用 Having，不是 Had；Had finished 是過去完成式的限定動詞，前面要有主詞（he／she 等），不能用來構成分詞片語。
Having 之後要接過去分詞 finished，不是原形 finish。
過去分詞 Finished 帶被動語氣，不能用主動意思接受詞 his homework（變成「他被做完」不通）；要表主動「先完成」必須用 Having finished。

practice.feedback: Having ＋ 過去分詞表先完成：Having finished his homework, he went out.

practice.stem: 哪一句正確（分詞主詞與主句一致）？
practice.answer: Having read the letter, Mary put it away.
options: Having read the letter, Mary put it away.
Having read the letter, the letter was put away.
Having read the letter, it was put away by Mary.
Having read the letter, putting it away.

distractor_rationales.Having read the letter, the letter was p: 讀信的是人，不是 the letter；主詞不一致＝垂懸分詞。
distractor_rationales.Having read the letter, it was put away: 主句主詞變成 it（被動），讀信的卻是 Mary；主詞不一致。
沒有主句的主要動詞，只有分詞，句子不完整。

practice.feedback: 分詞與主句同主詞 Mary：Having read the letter, Mary put it away.

practice.stem: 哪一句的分詞「沒有」垂懸（主詞一致、正確）？
practice.answer: Having eaten dinner, the children went to bed.
options: Having eaten dinner, the children went to bed.
Having eaten dinner, the dishes were washed.
Having eaten dinner, the table was cleared.
Having eaten dinner, it was time for bed.

distractor_rationales.Having eaten dinner, the dishes were was: 吃晚餐的是人，不是 the dishes；主詞不一致＝垂懸分詞。
distractor_rationales.Having eaten dinner, the table was clear: 吃晚餐的不是 the table；主詞不一致。
distractor_rationales.Having eaten dinner, it was time for bed: 主句主詞是虛主詞 it，不是吃晚餐的人；主詞不一致。

practice.feedback: 吃晚餐和上床的都是 the children，主詞一致：Having eaten dinner, the children went to bed.

practice.stem: 選出正確的被動完成分詞：____ about the storm, the sailors stayed in port.（他們被警告了）
options: Having been warned
Having warned
Having been warn
Being warned

distractor_rationales.Having warned: 這是主動，意思變成「水手警告了別人」；他們是被警告的，要用被動 Having been warned。
distractor_rationales.Having been warn: been 之後要接過去分詞 warned，不是原形 warn。
distractor_rationales.Being warned: Being warned 表示同時正在被警告，不強調「先完成」；完成被動要用 Having been warned。

practice.feedback: 被動完成分詞＝Having been ＋ 過去分詞：Having been warned about the storm, the sailors stayed in port.

practice.stem: 選出能正確接在後面的主句：Having missed the bus, ____
practice.answer: he took a taxi to school.
options: he took a taxi to school.
the taxi was expensive.
there was no other bus.
being late was a problem.

錯過公車的是人，不是 the taxi；主詞不一致＝垂懸分詞。
主句主詞是 there，不是錯過公車的人；主詞不一致。
主句主詞是 being late，不是錯過公車的人；主詞不一致。

practice.feedback: 錯過公車和搭計程車的都是 he，主詞一致：Having missed the bus, he took a taxi to school.
